extension.summary: Sports metadata scraper for Kodi, powered by Sportarr
extension.description:
Looks up leagues and events against your own Sportarr instance (or sportarr.net) instead of a generic TV database, so season and episode numbers always match exactly what Sportarr renamed the file to. Set the Sportarr server URL in this addon's settings, then choose "Sportarr" as the information provider on a TV Shows library pointed at your sports folder.
This is optional - Sportarr can also write local .nfo files and artwork directly (Settings, Local Metadata, in the Sportarr app), which Kodi reads natively with no addon at all. Install this addon only if you want Kodi to look events up dynamically instead.
extension.disclaimer: Requires a Sportarr instance or sportarr.net access. Configure the server URL in addon settings before scanning a library.

extension.description: Install this to get the Sportarr sports metadata scraper and receive updates to it automatically. Add this repository's zip via Kodi's file manager (Install from zip), then install "Sportarr" from Add-ons, Install from repository, Sportarr Repository.
